name: Citi Prestige Card
cardStatus: DISCONTINUED — no longer accepting new applications as of summer 2021. Existing cardholders may continue using the card.

loungeAccess.notes: Priority Pass Select membership included. Complimentary access for cardholder + guests. Enrollment required.

tripDelay.notes: 3-hour trigger is notably shorter than most cards. Verify current terms with Citi as benefits may change for legacy cardholders.

tripCancellation.notes: Benefit amounts may vary — existing cardholders should verify current terms with Citi.

emergencyMedical.notes: Concierge services available 24/7 for assistance. Does not provide emergency medical evacuation coverage.

hotelCredit.notes: $250 annual travel credit applied to travel purchases (airfare, hotels, car rentals). Applied as statement credit.

otherCredits.name: Fourth Night Free
otherCredits.notes: Complimentary fourth night free when booking 4+ consecutive hotel nights through ThankYou portal. Up to 2 times per year. A major benefit that can save hundreds.

rewards.travelRate: 5x on airlines and travel agencies; 3x on hotels and cruise lines

pointValue.transferPartners: varies (1:1 ratio to most partners like American Airlines, JetBlue, Singapore Airlines, etc.)

travelPerks: Fourth night free on hotel stays (up to 2x/year through ThankYou portal)
Trip delay coverage after just 3 hours
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 5 years
1:1 point transfer to 15+ airline and hotel partners
bestFor: Existing cardholders who frequently stay 4+ nights in hotels — the fourth-night-free benefit is uniquely valuable
